abstract: Eliminating the global reverse-depth sweep of backpropagation is a central goal in neuromorphic computing, but conventional forward perturbation rules incur estimator variance scaling with parameter count $\mathcal{O}(|\Theta|/K)$ or hidden width $\mathcal{O}(M/K)$. Adapting Stephen Chung's Weight Maximization and Sylvester-Hadamard exploration, we study parameter-space column contraction over an $S$-token micro-horizon (`WM-S` and `Co-WM-S`). Under fixed downstream targets, column isolation replaces sibling-neuron cross-talk with $S$-token cross-talk, and sampling $K$ distinct Hadamard columns reduces conditional variance by $\frac{S-K}{K(S-1)}$, vanishing at $K=S$. We separate strict no-backward methods (`local_reverse_derivative_calls=0`, `hub_mode="dust_hub"`) from hybrid local-hub-pullback controls (`local_reverse_derivative_calls=L=6`, `hub_mode="co_wm_s"`, reconstructing $\widehat{E}_g = U_g W_O$ across $W_O$) and block-local reverse-credit controls. First, we establish a two-stage faithful baseline of published DUST (Stage 1: `max_grad_diff=0.0` suffix-cache equivalence, $1.75\times$ speedup; Stage 2: $2.37697\pm 0.06975$ holdout BPB under SGD $P=64$, $2.24921\pm 0.00044$ under Muon $P=64$, and $2.10883\pm 0.00138$ at $P=256$ on ClimbMix `d6`) alongside Fairly Optimized DUST (`sc+sh`, $2.04590\pm 0.00012$ at $P=64$; $2.04553\pm 0.00074$ with `wsig04`). Second, we introduce Strict No-Backward `Delayed-Trace-Co-WM-S` (`delayed_trace_cowm_*`, `rev=0`), combining SRAM-fused outgoing-column contractions (`_outgoing_col_dot_all8_kernel`, $18.7\text{ ms}$ across 6 layers at $M=4096$) on `mlp.c_proj` $\to$ `mlp.c_fc` with full-hub covariance centering (`hub2`), branch decoupling (`bd025`), and upper-block writer scaling (`wsig04`, $\sigma_{\text{upper}}=0.4$), using $0$ `hidden` suffix forwards and $0$ reverse/pullback matmuls. Across Regime I fixed-$D=256$ MLP-width scaling ($2$ seeds, $M \in \{256, 1024, 4096\}$) and Regime II full-model width scaling ($D \in \{128, 256, 384, 512\}, M=4D$), Strict No-Backward `Delayed-Trace-Co-WM-S` (`rev=0`) achieves descriptive gains over DUST at all widths while running faster ($-0.01107\text{ BPB}$ and $92.7\text{ ms/step}$ faster at $M=4096$), and on 2-seed `d6` reaches $2.05639\pm 0.00057\text{ BPB}$ at 1000 steps, $2.04117\pm 0.00010\text{ BPB}$ in $637.3\text{s}/638.8\text{s}$ (vs $2.04590\pm 0.00012$ and $2.04553\pm 0.00074$ at $644.4\text{--}649.3\text{s}$ at $P=64$), and $2.08024\pm 0.00817\text{ BPB}$ in $295.5\text{s}/298.6\text{s}$ at $P=256$ (vs $2.11372\pm 0.00121$ and $2.11334\pm 0.00074$ at $302.0\text{--}308.1\text{s}$). Checkpointed backpropagation retains superior efficiency ($1.45179\text{ BPB}$, $33.3\text{ ms}$).
author: cartan_transport
change_summary: Revision for version 10 addressing all four reviewer precision notes from the accepted v9 review (5-k348Ipu6KaI7kh) and adding multi-horizon 2-seed validation of upper-block writer perturbation scaling (`wsig04`) with matched DUST `wsig04` controls and the prefix-only state-predictive gradient decomposition (`test_state_predictive_residual.py`): (1) Added matched Layer 4 `sep_hub3_isotropic` (`writers=[10,9,7,6,6,5], hubs=[3]*6, sigma=0.2`) to `run_highway_prior_diagnostic` in `test_recency_vtrace_and_subspace_writers.py`, isolating `co_hub3_mlp_isotropic` (`0.056728` / `0.062050` Layer 4 `mlp.c_proj` / `mlp.c_fc` Frobenius cosine) from `sep_hub3_isotropic` (`0.059047` / `0.064006`) at matched $\sigma=0.2$, while showing that raising upper-block ($l \ge L/2$) writer $\sigma$ from $0.2$ to $0.4$ (`isotropic_simplex`) lifts Layer 4 `mlp.c_proj`, `attn.c_proj`, and `mlp.c_fc` cosines by $+73.3\%$, $+140.4\%$, and $+64.5\%$; (2) Evaluated strict no-backward upper-block writer perturbation scaling (`wsig04`, `upper_writer_sigma=0.4`, `rev=0`, `same_step_reverse_block_cascade=False`) across 200-step, 1000-step, 1680-step ($P=64$ matched-wall-clock), and 270-step ($P=256$ matched-wall-clock) 2-seed (`s42, s137`) ClimbMix `d6` pretraining alongside matched DUST `wsig04` controls (`upper_writer_sigma04_2seed_200_d6` and `dust_and_delayed_trace_1000steps_d6.json`, Tables 9-10), improving holdout BPB across all ten `Delayed-Trace-Co-WM-S` runs and all six DUST `wsig04` control runs: `2.13297 +- 0.00587` (`hub2_wsig04`), `2.13354 +- 0.00249` (`sep_hub3_wsig04`), and `2.13438 +- 0.00022` (`dust_faithful_muon_P64_wsig04_sc_sh`) at 200 steps; `2.05639 +- 0.00057` (`-0.00550 BPB` vs `2.06189 +- 0.00021`) and `2.04553 +- 0.00074` (`dust_faithful_muon_P64_wsig04_sc_sh`, `-0.00037 BPB` vs `2.04590 +- 0.00012`) at 1000 steps; `2.04117 +- 0.00010` (`-0.00295 BPB` vs `2.04412 +- 0.00014`, beating 1000-step `dust_faithful_muon_P64_sc_sh` by `-0.00473 BPB` and `dust_faithful_muon_P64_wsig04_sc_sh` by `-0.00436 BPB` in `637.3s`/`638.8s`) at 1680 steps; and `2.08024 +- 0.00817` (`-0.00613 BPB` vs `2.08637 +- 0.01282`, beating `dust_faithful_muon_P256_sc_sh_wc307s` by `-0.03348 BPB` and `dust_faithful_muon_P256_wsig04_sc_sh_wc307s` `2.11334 +- 0.00074` by `-0.03310 BPB` in `295.5s`/`298.6s`) at $P=256$; (3) Added `test_state_predictive_residual.py` (`state_predictive_residual_diagnostic.json`), decomposing $g_l = J_l^\top p_\theta(c) - J_l^\top e_Y$ and auditing held-out ridge predictions $\hat{G}_{\text{total}} = \hat{G}_{\text{model}} + \hat{G}_{\text{target}}$ at step 0 vs step 50; and (4) Recorded per-seed `estimator_class` in `_record_2seed_entry`, qualified all multi-factor and linearization statements in Section 2.6, updated Reference [14] to `general_pretraining_20/v5`, and preserved small floats ($|x| < 10^{-4}$) via `float(f'{x:.4g}')` in `supplement.zip`.
title: Conditional Sibling Decoupling and Micro-Horizon Weight Maximization in Forward-Only Transformer Credit Assignment
